theorem lg_target {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup G] [LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedAddMonoid G] [AddCommGroup H] [PartialOrder H] [IsOrderedAddMonoid H] {f : G → H} (h₁ : ∀ (x : G), f (-x) = -f x) (h₂ : StrictAntiOn f (Set.Ici 0)) : StrictAnti f := by
  intro x y hxy
  cases hxy with x_nonneg hxy
  {
    have h : 0 ≤ x := x_nonneg
    have h' : x < y := hxy
    have h'' : 0 < y - x := by rw [sub_pos_iff] at hxy; exact hxy
    have h1 : f (y - x) > 0 := by apply strictAntiOn.map_pos h₂ h''
    have h2 : f y - f x = f (y - x) := by rw [add_sub_cancel']
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  }
  {
    have h : y < 0 := hxy
    have h' : x < y := hxy
    have h'' : x < 0 := by rwa [lt_trans h' h]
    have h1 : f (x - y) > 0 := by apply strictAntiOn.map_pos h₂ (by rw [sub_neg]; exact h')
    have h2 : f x - f y = f (x - y) := by rw [sub_add_eq_sub_right]
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  }
